generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Christmas market (圣诞集市). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Show a cosy European-style Christmas market at early blue hour from a visitor's eye level. One wooden chalet selling simple wooden toys occupies one side, while a decorated Christmas tree anchors the opposite side. String fairy lights form a gentle canopy above and one paper star lantern hangs distinctly below them; mount one evergreen wreath on the chalet. In the foreground, a gloved visitor holds one mug of steaming mulled drink beside a counter displaying a single gingerbread biscuit, wrapped present and knitted hat, all separated. Warm practical light against cool evening air, sparse background visitors, no snowstorm, commercial logos, price boards or readable stall text.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: wooden market chalet, string fairy lights, evergreen wreath, decorated Christmas tree, wrapped present, gingerbread biscuit, mug of mulled drink, knitted winter hat, wooden toy stall, paper star lantern.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
